GET    /web/api/v2.1/ranger/enablement
Get data about Accounts and Sites with self-enablement features (Ranger and Rogues) enabled.
Note: Currently, this feature is available only for MSSPs and distributors.
Best practice: Set filters. Each row is a set of parameters that quickly fills the pagination limits.
